verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 2 confirms the approved round-1 result. The event workflow passes the issue type through a quoted environment variable, and retriage obtains the mutable type from the same fail-closed live read as body and state. Untyped (`null`) is distinguished from absent or malformed schema, while display-cased names are normalized once at the classifier boundary. Existing trust-surface, kind, UI, and infrastructure precedence remains ahead of type/area fallback, so author selection of an org-defined type cannot move trust-plane work off its protected lane. The tests exercise the real workflow binding and forwarding seams, malformed live documents, typed versus untyped end-to-end label writes, and trust-surface precedence across the visible type space; their expected values are independently discriminating rather than tautological. No reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
